// Generate realistic-looking sparkline data
function spark(trend) {
  const n = 7;
  const data = [];
  let v = 50 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 20;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    v += (trend * 3) + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 12;
    v = Math.max(10, Math.min(90, v));
    data.push(v);
  }
  return data;
}

function svgSparkline(data, color) {
  const w = 80, h = 30;
  const mn = Math.min(...data), mx = Math.max(...data);
  const range = mx - mn || 1;
  const pts = data.map((v, i) => {
    const x = (i / (data.length - 1)) * (w - 4) + 2;
    const y = h - ((v - mn) / range) * (h - 4) - 2;
    return `${x},${y}`;
  }).join(' ');
  return `<svg class="sparkline" width="${w}" height="${h}" viewBox="0 0 ${w} ${h}">
    <polyline points="${pts}" fill="none" stroke="${color}" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/>

// Patch in correct prices for the top 10
function formatPrice(p) {
  if (p >= 1000) return '$' + p.toLocaleString('en-US', {minimumFractionDigits:2, maximumFractionDigits:2});
  if (p >= 1)    return '$' + p.toLocaleString('en-US', {minimumFractionDigits:2, maximumFractionDigits:4});
  return '$' + p.toPrecision(4);
}

function pctClass(v) { return v >= 0 ? 'up' : 'down'; }
function pctStr(v)   { return (v >= 0 ? '+' : '') + v.toFixed(2) + '%'; }

function renderSparkline(coin) {
  const data = spark(coin.trend);
  const color = coin.d1 >= 0 ? '#16C784' : '#EA3943';
  return svgSparkline(data, color);
}

let currentCat = 'top';
let currentNet = 'all';

const PER_PAGE = 100;
const TOTAL_PAGES = Math.ceil(TOTAL_ASSETS / PER_PAGE);

const CAT_DESCRIPTIONS = {
  top: 'Top cryptocurrencies by market capitalization',
  trending: 'Trending cryptocurrencies in the last 24 hours',
  watchlist: 'Your personal watchlist (log in to save)',
  prediction: 'Prediction market tokens',
  visited: 'Most visited assets this week',
  new: 'Recently listed cryptocurrencies',
  more: 'Additional categories',
};

const NET_FILTER = {
  all: null, bsc: ['BNB','CAKE','XVS'], sol: ['SOL','RAY','JTO'],
  base: ['AERO','BALD','BASE'], eth: ['ETH','UNI','AAVE','MKR','LINK','CRV','LDO'],
  'more-net': null,
};

function getFilteredCoins() {
  let coins = ALL_COINS.slice();
  // Network filter
  if (currentNet !== 'all' && currentNet !== 'more-net' && NET_FILTER[currentNet]) {
    coins = coins.filter(c => NET_FILTER[currentNet].includes(c.sym))
      .concat(coins.filter(c => !NET_FILTER[currentNet].includes(c.sym)));
  }
  // Category filter adjustments
  if (currentCat === 'trending') {
    coins = [...coins].sort((a, b) => Math.abs(b.d1) - Math.abs(a.d1));
  } else if (currentCat === 'visited') {
    coins = [...coins].sort((a, b) => Math.abs(b.vol?.replace(/[^0-9.]/g,'') || 0) - Math.abs(a.vol?.replace(/[^0-9.]/g,'') || 0));
  } else if (currentCat === 'new') {
    coins = [...coins].reverse();
  } else if (currentCat === 'watchlist') {
    coins = coins.filter(c => starredCoins.has(c.sym));
  } else if (currentCat === 'prediction') {
    coins = coins.filter(c => ['GNO','BETS','DRIFT'].includes(c.sym)).concat(coins.slice(0,5));
  }
  return coins;
}

function renderPagination(total) {
  const totalPgs = Math.min(Math.ceil((total || TOTAL_ASSETS) / PER_PAGE), 84);
  const info = document.getElementById('pageCountInfo');
  const start = (currentPage - 1) * PER_PAGE + 1;
  const end = Math.min(currentPage * PER_PAGE, currentPage === 1 ? 100 : total);
  info.textContent = `Showing ${start}–${Math.min(start + 99, TOTAL_ASSETS)} of ${TOTAL_ASSETS.toLocaleString()} assets`;

  const btns = document.getElementById('pageButtons');
  const pages = [1,2,3,4];
  let html = `<button class="page-btn prev-next" onclick="setPage(${Math.max(1,currentPage-1)})">‹ Prev</button>`;
  pages.forEach(p => {
    html += `<button class="page-btn ${p===currentPage?'active':''}" onclick="setPage(${p})">${p}</button>`;
  });
  html += `<button class="page-btn ellipsis">…</button>`;
  html += `<button class="page-btn" onclick="setPage(${totalPgs})">${totalPgs}</button>`;
  html += `<button class="page-btn prev-next" onclick="setPage(${Math.min(totalPgs,currentPage+1)})">Next ›</button>`;
  btns.innerHTML = html;
}

function setPage(p) {
  currentPage = p;

function toggleColumn(cls, visible) {

  cells.forEach(c => {
    c.style.display = visible ? '' : 'none';
  });
}

/* ─── Panel toggle ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
function togglePanel(panelId, btnId) {
  const panel = document.getElementById(panelId);
  const btn = document.getElementById(btnId);
  const isOpen = panel.classList.contains('open');
  // Close all panels first
  document.querySelectorAll('.dropdown-panel').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('open'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.ctrl-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('open'));
  if (!isOpen) {
    panel.classList.add('open');
    btn.classList.add('open');
  }
}

// Close panels on outside click
document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
  if (!e.target.closest('.panel-wrapper')) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.dropdown-panel').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('open'));
    document.querySelectorAll('.ctrl-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('open'));
  }
});

/* ─── Sort ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
let sortField = '24h';
let sortDir = -1;

function sortTable(field) {
  if (sortField === field) sortDir *= -1;
  else { sortField = field; sortDir = -1; }
  ALL_COINS.sort((a, b) => {
    let av, bv;
    if (field === '1h') { av = a.h1; bv = b.h1; }
    else if (field === '24h') { av = a.d1; bv = b.d1; }
    else if (field === '7d') { av = a.d7; bv = b.d7; }
    else if (field === 'mcap') { av = parseFloat(a.mcap.replace(/[^0-9.]/g,'')); bv = parseFloat(b.mcap.replace(/[^0-9.]/g,'')); }
    else if (field === 'vol') { av = parseFloat(a.vol.replace(/[^0-9.]/g,'')); bv = parseFloat(b.vol.replace(/[^0-9.]/g,'')); }
    return sortDir * (av - bv);
  });
  renderTable();
}

/* ─── Watchlist star ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
function toggleStar(sym, el) {
  if (starredCoins.has(sym)) {
    starredCoins.delete(sym);
    el.textContent = '☆';
    el.classList.remove('starred');
  } else {
    starredCoins.add(sym);
    el.textContent = '★';
    el.classList.add('starred');
  }
}

      chip.textContent = t;
      container.insertBefore(chip, btn);
    });
    btn.textContent = 'Less ‹';
  } else {

    btn.textContent = 'More ›';
  }
}
